facts: The conditions in race 8 of the 420 open gold fleet were 13 knots of wind and 1 meter waves.
At the starting line, 30 seconds before the start, SLO 56869 was close-hauled on starboard tack to windward of UKR 57726, bow to bow, at a lateral distance of one boat length.
The distance between boats was one and a half boat lengths.
20 seconds before the start, SLO 56869 bore away and UKR 57726 luffed up to head to wind.
Immediately after that, SLO 56869 luffed up to head to wind.
UKR 57726 backed the jib and bore away.
The minimum distance between boats was half a boat length.
conclusions: SLO 56869 to windward kept clear of UKR 57726 to leeward, as required by RRS 11.
